title: [PowerDisplay] Refresh Rate

status.label: Validated mode-selector inline suggestion
status.detail: One current-revision inline suggestion keeps Off available when no internal refresh rates are detected, retaining the preset capability and setter guards. The exact literal candidate compiled Settings UI and its test project; both compile roots exited zero but required forced cleanup of owned helpers after their natural-drain deadlines. The later no-build test run naturally drained and passed 51 cases: 33 target PowerDisplay cases and 18 additional prefix-selected profile cases. This is a source-grounded draft, not an interactive UI reproduction or clean automated review. Six confirmed requests and three unmatched event reservations are retained conservatively; no additional automated request is authorized.

next_action: Review the pinned mode-selector suggestion and explicitly choose whether to post it. UI interaction remains unverified; no upstream action has been taken.

proposed_comments.body:
[P2] Keep Off available when no internal refresh rates are detected

A previously saved non-Off battery mode can coexist with an empty `InternalDisplayRefreshRates` list: monitor publication writes an empty list when no internal display is found, and the Settings reload updates that list without resetting the saved mode. This card then disables the entire mode selector through `CanUseBatteryRefreshRate`, including Off. The `BatteryRefreshRateModeIndex` setter already permits Off without capability and rejects unsupported non-Off modes, but the disabled parent prevents selecting it. Remove only this card-level capability binding; keep the preset card and the existing setter guards unchanged. Verify with a saved non-Off mode and no detected rates that Off is selectable and persists, while the preset stays disabled and unsupported modes remain rejected.

```suggestion
                                    CornerRadius="4,4,0,0">
```

confidence.rationale: Pinned source shows the saved non-Off/empty-rates state and a disabled parent that prevents the existing Off setter escape. The literal XAML compiles and existing PowerDisplay unit cases pass. No interactive UI reproduction is claimed.
